item.text: {"summary":"Consolidated six frozen draft proposals into five mechanism labels; recovery and outcome remain separate attributes.","labels":[{"id":"c01","name":"dialog dismissal failure","description":"Repeated attempts to dismiss a dialog do not visibly restore the underlying workspace.","aliases":["repeated_dialog_dismissal_without_restoration"],"status":"draft"},{"id":"c02","name":"off-target UI targeting","description":"Repeated UI targeting misses the intended control and leads to unrelated or absent UI states.","aliases":["Repeated control targeting misses","off_target_menu_navigation"],"status":"draft"},{"id":"c03","name":"off-target retrieval path","description":"The attempt pursues an alternative retrieval route instead of establishing the requested browser result.","aliases":["off-target retrieval path"],"status":"draft"},{"id":"c04","name":"proxy access failure","description":"A visible proxy authentication or access error blocks or may block browser access.","aliases":["proxy access failure"],"status":"draft"},{"id":"c05","name":"numeric field append error","description":"Input is appended to an existing numeric field value instead of replacing it.","aliases":["numeric_field_append_without_clear"],"status":"draft"}],"mappings":[{"proposal_id":"p001","canonical_label_id":"c01","rationale":"The Function Wizard remained visible after repeated dismissal attempts; this is a dialog-state failure, not merely an unsuccessful click."},{"proposal_id":"p002","canonical_label_id":"c03","rationale":"The episode used wttr.in and terminal commands instead of establishing the requested browser page, a strategy/path deviation distinct from proxy access."},{"proposal_id":"p003","canonical_label_id":"c04","rationale":"The browser visibly reported ERR_PROXY_AUTH_UNSUPPORTED, indicating an access-layer failure; its causal effect on later retrieval remains uncertain."},{"proposal_id":"p004","canonical_label_id":"c02","rationale":"Repeated clicks missed the intended Layers-panel control and the dialog opened only after a shortcut; this shares the targeting-miss mechanism with p005."},{"proposal_id":"p005","canonical_label_id":"c02","rationale":"Menu targeting led to unrelated dialogs rather than footer controls, matching the same off-target UI targeting mechanism as p004 despite a different UI area."},{"proposal_id":"p006","canonical_label_id":"c05","rationale":"Typing produced 75 from an existing 2 rather than replacing the field value, which is a distinct input-editing mechanism."}],"unresolved":["The proxy error is visible, but whether it caused all later retrieval problems is not established.","Intermediate UI states are sparse, so the exact causes of some targeting misses in p004 and p005 are not proven."]}
